notes.title: Version 1.1 + New Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi, all!

It's been a while. Today, we've uploaded version 1.1 of Blossoms Bloom Brightest. Although it was quite a while ago, we also lowered the price of each DLC pack to $1 USD.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/446650/Blossoms_Bloom_Brightest__Guide_Book/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/624280/Blossoms_Bloom_Brightest__Erica_Daki/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/624281/Blossoms_Bloom_Brightest__Kotoha_Daki/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/624282/Blossoms_Bloom_Brightest__Sara_Daki/

Version 1.1 change log:
 3 new achievements
 Sound effects added
 Image gallery added
 Many typos fixed
 Engine updated
 Sprite transitions smoothed
 Initial sound levels adjusted
 Misc. small QoL changes

notes.title: Galaxy Girls Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the complete remake and expansion of this original free to play game is now available from today on Steam. Adding even more story content, a new character to explore and a complete expansion to the games art.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/560250/Galaxy_Girls/

Checkout the store page now, as on the week of release there will be a number of discounts and bonus sets available for buyers to take advantage of including discounts on the main game, Day 1 DLC and our season pass. As well as our Deluxe edition Bundle with further discount available.
